usage.callShape: GET https://api.agentphone.ai/x402/v1/calls/{call_id}/recording where {call_id} is the id returned by a prior POST /x402/v1/calls (an actual placed AI voice call). Pays via x402 on Base; price varies.
usage.outputShape: Untested. Expected to return the audio recording (binary/audio content type) or a JSON wrapper with a recording URL for the call identified by {call_id}.
quirks: URL has an unresolved path placeholder {call_id} that cannot be filled from schema/instructions (all null) — you must first place a real outbound voice call via POST /x402/v1/calls (up to $0.50, outward/irreversible) and capture the returned call id.
Recordings are wallet-scoped: only the wallet that placed the call can read its recording (per service description).
Real backend behind the 402 header is api.paysponge.com (transparent proxy); api.agentphone.ai/x402/v1 is the gateway entry point.
Calls flow uses x402 'upto'/permit2 (up to $0.50), distinct from the 'exact' $0.01 scheme used by /numbers.
usage.guide: This endpoint reads the audio recording of an AI voice call you previously placed through AgentPhone. You cannot call it standalone: first POST https://api.agentphone.ai/x402/v1/calls to place an outbound AI voice call and save the returned call id, then GET https://api.agentphone.ai/x402/v1/calls/{call_id}/recording with that id to retrieve the recording. Recordings are wallet-scoped, so use the same wallet that placed the call. It pays via x402 on Base. Not pay-tested in this run because no call_id was available and fabricating one would just hit a 404.
